paraphrase: The app should offer features, content and UI beyond a repackaged website and have real utility or lasting value, or it may not be accepted; it should not be primarily marketing material, ads, web clippings, an aggregator or a list of links; it should work without installing another app; if it must download additional resources to function on first launch, disclose the download size and prompt the user first; template-generated apps are rejected unless submitted by the content owner; remote desktop clients that mirror specific software have their own conditions.
quote: Your app should work on its own without requiring installation of another app to function
